config.selectionRule: Use the completed independently audited cost screen's selected WASM target and evaluator variant with the unchanged full model. No alternate model, search setting, or game result enters this study.
config.fixedWork: Each worker-count setting executes the same 72 cost roots once in each of three blocks: 216 searches per setting, 648 measured searches total. These are 72 distinct roots, not 216 independent positions.
config.blockOrder: Replicate 0: 1,2,4 workers. Replicate 1: 2,4,1. Replicate 2: 4,1,2. All blocks complete exactly once; no retries or early stopping.
config.jobOrder: Cost root order for replicate 0, reversed for replicate 1, rotated left by 24 for replicate 2. Deterministic round-robin assignment by ordinal modulo worker count; each worker receives the same number of jobs and phase balance.
config.warmup: Fresh independent Node process and WASM instance per worker per block. Exact cost flags and 32 authored warmups; all workers reach READY after loading the measured roots, before the common GO barrier. Empty root history matches the static cost screen; the full-history game protocol is separate.
config.timing: Coordinator batch wall time runs from before GO broadcast through receipt of all DONE replies, including scheduling, IPC and result serialization. Per-search latency is the synchronous WASM call from the existing frozen host. Compilation, loading, parsing and warmup are excluded from both measured intervals.
config.affinity: Workers use the first 1/2/4 available CPU slots; coordinator uses the last available distinct slot. Record exact affinity, CPU model, process CPU time and exposed cgroup metadata. Missing quota files mean unknown quota, not unlimited CPU.
config.memory: Record each worker's RSS at READY and completion and Linux process-lifetime peak RSS. Sum of worker peaks is an upper bound, not a simultaneous memory sample. Record fixed linear memory separately; coordinator RSS is excluded.
config.exactness: All 648 search signatures must equal the selected full-model cost signatures: nodes,qnodes,depth,attempted_depth,score,move,stop_reason,cutoffs,researches,tt_saturated. Every job and worker must appear exactly once. A mismatch invalidates the full study.
config.interpretation: Independent-job throughput and concurrent per-search latency only. No search-tree parallelism, individual-move speedup, production thread activation, Elo, or new quality claim.
config.publication: Freeze source, config, selected module/model/rules/host, all cost signature inputs, Node/taskset identities and CPU policy before timing. New exclusive directories, read-only snapshots, verified executable inodes, data first and authenticated completion metadata last. Preserve failures. Run only after games and their audit release the CPU.

environment.quotaObservation: Missing cgroup files do not establish an unlimited CPU quota; affinity is not a CPU-time entitlement.
